# iMathMate

> iMathMate is an AI math tuition system that turns a photo of any math problem into a clear, step-by-step lesson. It is built to teach the method and the reasoning behind each step — not just hand over the final answer — and to identify and close each student's weak areas over time.

iMathMate is a mobile app (iOS and Android) for K–12 and early-college students. Core capabilities: snap-and-solve from a photo, step-by-step explanations (the "why", "how" and "what" of every step), an AI chat tutor, concept-based learning, quizzes, progress tracking, and personalised learning roadmaps.

## Product
- [How It Works](https://imathmate.com/how-it-works): The four-stage flow from a photo of a problem to real understanding.
- [Snap & Solve](https://imathmate.com/snap-and-solve): Take a photo of any math problem and get a guided learning path.
- [Step-by-Step Solutions](https://imathmate.com/step-by-step-solutions): Explanations of the method behind every step, not just the answer.
- [Quiz Mode](https://imathmate.com/quiz-mode): Focused quizzes to check understanding and find weak areas.
- [Progress Tracking](https://imathmate.com/progress-tracking): Track solved problems, quiz performance and weak topics over time.
- [Save to Gallery](https://imathmate.com/save-to-gallery): Save solved problems for later revision.
- [Streak Rewards](https://imathmate.com/streak-rewards): Rewards for consistent daily practice.
- [Math Topics](https://imathmate.com/math-topics): Coverage from arithmetic through calculus.
- [Practice Problems](https://imathmate.com/practice-problems): Sample problems across Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry and Calculus.
